EVT_2026_001.input_title: Ministry of Finance notifies 16% escalation in National Calamity Contingent Duty (NCCD) on cigarettes and specified tobacco items
EVT_2026_001.input_content: The Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, has issued a notification revising the excise and NCCD schedule on tobacco products by 16% effective immediately.
EVT_2026_001.interpretation: In this sample, a tobacco duty increase could put pressure on margins if manufacturers cannot pass it through to customers.
EVT_2026_001.mechanism: Higher duty -> higher tax burden per pack -> potential price increases or lower margins -> possible volume response.
EVT_2026_001.similarity: The selected tobacco tax case illustrates the same tax-to-pricing channel.
EVT_2026_001.differences: Tax structure, product mix and consumer response may differ. Sector membership alone does not establish the size of a company effect.
EVT_2026_001.caveat: The magnitude, timing and market pricing of any effect are unknown. This is an illustrative scenario, not an observed announcement.

EVT_2026_002.input_title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee shifts policy stance from 'Withdrawal of Accommodation' to 'Neutral'; retains Repo Rate at 6.50%
EVT_2026_002.input_content: The Monetary Policy Committee voted unanimously to revise the monetary policy stance to 'Neutral', signaling flexibility while maintaining vigilance on food inflation.
EVT_2026_002.interpretation: A neutral policy stance in this sample permits policy flexibility. It does not promise rate cuts or higher bank earnings.
EVT_2026_002.mechanism: Stance change -> broader set of possible policy paths -> uncertain funding and lending rate adjustments.
EVT_2026_002.similarity: The rate-cycle case illustrates how monetary policy can affect credit conditions.
EVT_2026_002.differences: A neutral stance differs from an actual rate change. Deposit costs, loan repricing and inflation could move differently.
EVT_2026_002.caveat: Bank margins can improve or deteriorate depending on repricing. No directional stock conclusion is established.

EVT_2026_003.input_title: NCLT sanctions scheme of demerger of Tata Motors into two separate listed entities for Commercial and Passenger Vehicles
EVT_2026_003.input_content: Tata Motors Ltd has received the certified true copy of the order passed by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Mumbai Bench sanctioning the scheme of arrangement for demerger.
EVT_2026_003.interpretation: A demerger in this sample could change capital allocation and segment disclosure. Value creation is not automatic.
EVT_2026_003.mechanism: Legal separation -> separate accounts and capital decisions -> possible changes in operating focus.
EVT_2026_003.similarity: The bank consolidation case offers only a broad comparison about organizational restructuring.
EVT_2026_003.differences: A merger combines businesses; a demerger separates them. This is a weak comparison, not evidence of a common valuation outcome.
EVT_2026_003.caveat: Standalone debt allocation, execution costs and future disclosures are needed before judging benefits.

EVT_2026_004.input_title: Red Sea shipping freight rates jump 45% amid persistent container rerouting around Cape of Good Hope
EVT_2026_004.input_content: Ocean container carriers report transit delays of 12-14 days and bunker fuel surcharges, impacting Indian merchandise export consignments to Europe.
EVT_2026_004.interpretation: Shipping disruption in this sample could increase delivery costs and working-capital needs for exposed exporters.
EVT_2026_004.mechanism: Rerouting -> longer journeys -> potential freight costs and delayed deliveries -> cash-flow pressure.
EVT_2026_004.similarity: The crude shock case illustrates an external input-cost channel.
EVT_2026_004.differences: Oil prices and freight capacity have different drivers. Contract coverage and routes vary by exporter.
EVT_2026_004.caveat: Two named media entries in a fixture do not prove independent reporting. No live article has been checked.
